# Closed context producer

This owned fixture preserves a closed binary context and an independent invariant producer of the method's own Object result. A static entry forwards to the original virtual method, which invokes the closed context, performs its original concrete result cast, invokes the producer, and retains the declared checked exception contract.

Four frozen caller routes compare 240 fresh cases twice, checking receiver reuse and overrides, nulls, callback and result identity, mutations, exact checked/runtime/error failures, partial effects and delayed casts. Twenty independently wrong programs and eight same-Code Signature controls qualify the observations. Source and SDK profiles compile every emitted unit and compare complete class/method definitions, access roles, Signature and Exceptions.

All inputs and names are independently owned examples.
